mcat_description.short: Metal Shelters are prefabricated steel-framed structures supplied as ready-to-erect or bolt-together assemblies for industrial, commercial, agricultural, and public-use applications. They are sold as complete structural units or custom-fabricated to buyer dimensions, typically in mild steel, GI, or aluminium with colour-coated or galvanised roofing sheets.
mcat_description.long: Metal Shelters encompass a broad range of prefabricated and pre-engineered steel structures designed for rapid on-site assembly without conventional masonry construction. In the Indian B2B market, the dominant commercial form is the mild steel prefabricated industrial or storage shelter — a portal-frame or truss-based structure with colour-coated GI or Galvalume roofing sheets, designed and fabricated as per IS 800:2007 (General Construction in Steel) and IS 875 for load calculations. Product types range from heavy-duty industrial storage sheds and factory shelters to lighter parking canopies, bus shelters, guard cabins, and portable site offices, with structural materials spanning mild steel, Corten steel, aluminium, and galvanised iron. Buyers typically specify custom dimensions, roof pitch, wall panel type (open, PUF-insulated, or sandwich panel), and surface treatment (red oxide primer + enamel, powder coat, or hot-dip galvanising), and sellers quote on a per-square-foot or per-unit basis depending on whether the structure is custom-fabricated or catalogue-standard.

market_context: In the Indian B2B market, Metal Shelters sit within the broader prefabricated structures segment and are primarily understood as mild steel or GI-framed prefabricated structures for industrial, storage, agricultural, and public-use applications. The primary structural design standard is IS 800:2007 (General Construction in Steel — Code of Practice), which governs limit state design for steel shelters, sheds, canopies, and industrial buildings; load calculations follow IS 875. Structural steel used in fabrication is subject to BIS certification requirements, with IS 2062 being the key standard for structural steel plates and sections used in shelter fabrication — ISI-marked steel is increasingly demanded by government and institutional buyers. The market spans a wide range of product types: heavy-duty industrial storage sheds and factory shelters (dominant segment), parking canopies, bus shelters, guard cabins, portable site offices, and exhibition structures. Materials commonly used include mild steel (MS), galvanised iron (GI), Corten steel, aluminium, and Galvalume-coated sheets; surface treatments include red oxide zinc chromate primer with synthetic enamel topcoat, powder coating, and hot-dip galvanising. Sellers are concentrated in Delhi-NCR, Hyderabad, Faridabad, Bengaluru, Indore, and Coimbatore manufacturing clusters. The category shows contamination from unrelated products (shower enclosures, decorative oil burners) based on keyword signals — listing audit should flag these as wrong-MCAT placements. Unit quoting is predominantly per sq ft for custom structures and per piece for standard portable units.
